#en: Once more unto the breach!
zh: 再度冲入缺口！

#en: We got this!
zh: 我们能行！

#en: They picked the wrong ship to mess with.
zh: 他们挑错了要招惹的飞船。

#en: Shields up, safety's off!
zh: 护盾升起，保险关闭！

#en: Enemy on sensors!
zh: 传感器发现敌人！

#en: Time to dance.
zh: 该跳舞了。

#en: Show 'em what we've got!
zh: 让他们见识见识我们的本事！

#en: Buckle up!
zh: 系好安全带！

#en: We win!
zh: 我们赢了！

#en: Haha, you've got a real knack for this!
zh: 哈哈，你这方面真有天分！

#en: Let's see what they left behind.
zh: 看看他们留下了什么。

#en: Time to breathe again...
zh: 总算能喘口气了……

#en: Kinda fun, but glad it's over.
zh: 挺好玩，但很高兴它结束了。

#en: They never stood a chance.
zh: 他们根本毫无胜算。

#en: We're clear, good work!
zh: 威胁解除，干得好！

#en: Nothing but space dust now.
zh: 现在只剩太空尘埃了。

#en: Made it in one piece.
zh: 我们完好无损。

#en: Nice flying!
zh: 飞得漂亮！

#en: Shields need fixing, fast!
zh: 护盾需要抢修，快！

#en: The ship can't survive another hit like that!
zh: 飞船经不起再来那么一下了！

#en: We need those shields back online, now!
zh: 我们需要护盾立刻恢复！

#en: We're not winning this without shields!
zh: 没有护盾我们赢不了！

#en: Shield systems are down!
zh: 护盾系统失效！

#en: We can't take another hit with no shields!
zh: 没有护盾我们挨不起第二下！

#en: Starting shield repairs now!
zh: 现在开始修复护盾！

#en: We're exposed without shields!
zh: 没有护盾我们完全暴露！

#en: Shields just went offline!
zh: 护盾刚刚离线！

#en: Our shields are down!
zh: 我们的护盾失效了！

#en: We lost a weapon!
zh: 我们损失了一件武器！

#en: Weapon system down...
zh: 武器系统失效……

#en: One of our guns is shot...
zh: 我们有一门炮被打坏了……

#en: Lost a weapon, can't return fire!
zh: 损失一件武器，无法还击！

#en: Damn. Weapon's toast!
zh: 该死。武器废了！

#en: That shot crippled a weapon.
zh: 那一击打瘫了一件武器。

#en: Not good, we're down a gun!
zh: 不妙，我们少了一门炮！

#en: Weapon's offline...
zh: 武器离线……

#en: They knocked out one of our guns!
zh: 他们打坏了我们一门炮！

#en: Agh, we lost a weapon.
zh: 啊，我们损失了一件武器。

#en: We're good on weapons!
zh: 我们的武器没事！

#en: Weapons repaired!
zh: 武器已修复！

#en: Feel free to fire, guns working again.
zh: 尽管开火，炮又能用了。

#en: We've got weapons again!
zh: 我们又有武器了！

#en: Repairs complete! Weapons ready.
zh: 维修完成！武器就绪。

#en: Guns are back!
zh: 炮回来了！

#en: Weapon systems repaired!
zh: 武器系统已修复！

#en: We're back in business, fire away!
zh: 我们又行了，开火吧！

#en: Weapon's good to go!
zh: 武器可以用了！

#en: Our guns are back online!
zh: 我们的炮重新上线了！

#en: One less gun pointed our way.
zh: 对着我们的炮少了一门。

#en: They're down some firepower now.
zh: 他们的火力减了些。

#en: That weapon's kaput!
zh: 那件武器报废了！

#en: Weapon offline on their end!
zh: 他们那边有武器离线了！

#en: Oh, look at that! You got one of their weapons!
zh: 哦，瞧瞧！你打掉了他们一件武器！

#en: They won't be firing that one anytime soon.
zh: 那门炮一时半会儿开不了火了。

#en: One more enemy weapon offline!
zh: 又一件敌方武器离线！

#en: Knocked out their guns!
zh: 打瘫了他们的炮！

#en: They're down a weapon!
zh: 他们少了一件武器！

#en: Nice shot! One of their guns just went offline.
zh: 好枪法！他们有一门炮刚离线了。

#en: They've got their weapons systems!
zh: 他们的武器系统恢复了！

#en: Enemy weapons just sprang back to life!
zh: 敌方武器突然又恢复运作了！

#en: Look out, they've rearmed!
zh: 当心，他们重新武装了！

#en: They're ready to blast us again, stay sharp!
zh: 他们准备好再轰我们一轮了，保持警觉！

#en: Their weapons are back!
zh: 他们的武器回来了！

#en: Uh-oh, they patched up their guns!
zh: 哎呀，他们把炮修好了！

#en: Those guns are alive again!
zh: 那些炮又活了！

#en: They fixed their weapons. Time for round two!
zh: 他们修好了武器。第二回合开始！

#en: Their weapons are hot again!
zh: 他们的武器又热起来了！

#en: They've got their guns back online!
zh: 他们的炮重新上线了！

#en: Hm. Kinda sad we're done. It made for an interesting talk!
zh: 嗯。聊完了还有点遗憾。这话题挺有意思的！

#en: Feel free to ask about anything "Starborn"! Any time, any place.
zh: 有关"星裔"的任何事都尽管问！随时，随地。

#en: If there's anything else you're curious about, feel free to ask.
zh: 如果你还好奇别的什么，尽管问。

#en: That's all I wanted to ask about Starborn and Unity.
zh: 关于星裔和归一，我想问的就这些了。

#en: Starborn relationships can be... unique, to say the least.
zh: 星裔之间的关系，往轻了说，都称得上……独特。

#en: Alright, we can explore that.
zh: 好，我们可以聊聊这个。

#en: Interacting with others isn't always straightforward for us...
zh: 对我们来说，与人往来并不总是那么简单……

#en: I'm curious about how Starborn interact with others.
zh: 我很好奇星裔如何与他人相处。

#en: I can share what I've pieced together so far.
zh: 我可以分享我目前拼凑出的东西。

#en: Sure! Although, still figuring a lot of it out myself.
zh: 当然！不过很多我自己也还在琢磨。

#en: Pretty deep subjects, but I'm game if you are!
zh: 话题挺深的，但你有兴趣我就奉陪！

#en: Let's talk about Starborn and Unity, specifically.
zh: 我们就具体聊聊星裔和归一吧。

#en: Sure, I suppose I can share a little.
zh: 好，我想我可以透露一点。

#en: Okay then, let's get personal.
zh: 那好，我们聊点私人的。

#en: Alright, let's talk about me!
zh: 好，聊聊我自己吧！

#en: I'd like to know more about your personal experiences.
zh: 我想多了解一些你的亲身经历。

#en: I'll take my leave. You'll know where to find me.
zh: 我先告辞了。你知道去哪儿找我。

#en: Do you have anything for me, Torin?
zh: 你有什么要给我的吗，托林？

#en: Don't say I never give you anything. Here.
zh: 别说我从不给你东西。拿着。

#en: Keep an eye out for people like that. They could be potential allies! Or they might be a future threat, another Starborn-in-waiting.
zh: 留意那样的人。他们可能是潜在的盟友！也可能成为未来的威胁，又一个即将成为星裔的人。

#en: That said, once in a while you do find someone who notices and remembers...
zh: 话虽如此，偶尔你确实会遇到注意到并记住这些的人……

#en: Starborn powers, floating rocks and strange temples, they just seem to dismiss such things as... unimportant anomalies!
zh: 星裔能力、漂浮的岩石、奇异的神殿，他们似乎只是把这类东西当作……无关紧要的异常现象一笔带过！

#en: They don't exactly forget, but they do seem to decide none of it's important enough to really think about.
zh: 他们并非真的忘记，但似乎认定这些都不重要到值得去认真琢磨。

#en: They do and they don't. People see the strange things we do, but they usually just write it all off.
zh: 既记得又不记得。人们看得到我们做的怪事，但通常只是把它们一概否定。

#en: Don't normal people notice any of the weird stuff?
zh: 普通人不会注意到那些怪事吗？

#en: I'm sorry if it felt like I was keeping secrets. But I did what I thought was best -- so you could become the Starborn you were meant to be.
zh: 如果让你觉得我在藏着掖着，我很抱歉。但我做的是我认为最好的选择——好让你成为你命中注定要成为的那个星裔。

#en: I was worried that if I laid it all out too soon, I'd disrupt your path, rob you of the growth you needed. You had to figure it out on your own time.
zh: 我担心如果过早地说清楚，会扰乱你的道路，剥夺你所需的成长。你得在自己的节奏里弄明白。

#en: Becoming Starborn isn't just about hoarding artifacts, it's a journey, a shift in perspective.
zh: 成为星裔不只是囤积神器，而是一段旅程，一种视角的转变。

#en: Why not tell Harper and Gren about everything?
zh: 为什么不把一切都告诉哈珀和格伦？

#en: I will tell them eventually, but only when I'm sure they can handle it. Right now just isn't that time.
zh: 我终究会告诉他们的，但只在确定他们能承受的时候。现在还不是时候。

#en: I don't want Harper or Gren to have to deal with any of that... I care about them.
zh: 我不想让哈珀或格伦去面对这些……我在乎他们。

#en: They either find themselves targeted by Starborn, or god forbid, Watchtower, start to lose their grip on reality, or get pulled onto a path they aren't ready for.
zh: 他们要么被星裔盯上，要么——但愿不会——被瞭望塔盯上，要么开始失去对现实的把握，要么被拽上一条他们还没准备好的路。

#en: For most people, learning about The Unity and everything around it, assuming they understand what they're told, it tends to go one of three ways...
zh: 对大多数人来说，了解到归一及其周遭的一切——假设他们真听懂了——往往会走向三种结局之一……

#en: Something I am sure of, though, is that we don't seem to age! My clock stopped ticking a while ago. Kind of freaky, but hey, all part of the Starborn package.
zh: 不过有一点我确定：我们似乎不会变老！我的钟早就不走了。有点瘆人，但嘿，这也是星裔套餐的一部分。

#en: I don't know if it's really them, or just their memories that survive, but it might explain why some Starborn act like they're immortal daredevils.
zh: 我不知道存活下来的是他们本人，还是仅仅是他们的记忆，但这也许解释了为什么有些星裔活得像个不死的亡命之徒。

#en: So, my working theory is -- whenever a Starborn dies, their consciousness simply "slides" into another universe's version of themselves!
zh: 所以，我目前的推测是——每当星裔死去，他们的意识就只是"滑入"了另一个宇宙中的自己身上！

#en: Now, I could be wrong, but I'm fairly sure that's happened to me too. I died, and I remember it happening. But as you can see, I currently seem to be alive!
zh: 嗯，我也许错了，但我挺肯定这也在我身上发生过。我死了，而且我记得那过程。但你也看到了，我现在似乎还活着！

#en: Good question. I'm sure by now you've noticed -- that whenever you take down a Starborn they just crumble away into glowing dust.
zh: 好问题。我肯定你已经注意到了——每当你击倒一个星裔，他们都会化成发光的尘埃消散。

#en: So, can we die? And when we jump, is that still us?
zh: 那么，我们会死吗？当我们跳跃时，那还是我们吗？

#en: Now, I used to get new equipment and even a ship when I jumped, but, heh, not anymore... Apparently, now those things are just too good for stinky old Torin!
zh: 以前我跳跃的时候还能拿到新装备甚至一艘飞船，但嘿，现在不行了……显然，这些东西如今配不上臭烘烘的老托林了！

#en: I find myself dumped on some random planet, naked as the day I was born, in a brand new universe.
zh: 我发现自己被扔到某个随机行星上，赤条条像个刚出生的人，置身于一个全新的宇宙。

#en: Then as I try to move closer, it gets louder. Too loud! Like it's gonna tear my skull apart. Then, right when I think my mind will split in two...
zh: 然后当我试着靠近，那声音就更响了。太响了！像要把我的头骨撕开。然后，就在我以为自己的心智要裂成两半时……

#en: For me, The Unity is an endless void where I'm just... floating. I see a faint light way off in the distance. It calls to me, but I can't make out the words.
zh: 对我来说，归一是一片无尽的虚空，我只是……漂浮着。我远远地看见一点微光。它在呼唤我，但我听不清那些词句。

#en: Now you see, that's interesting... Because no two Starborn seem to describe it in exactly the same way.
zh: 你看，这就很有意思了……因为似乎没有两个星裔的描述是完全一样的。

#en: When you enter The Unity, what's it like for you?
zh: 你进入归一的时候，那对你来说是什么感觉？

#en: At a guess? I think there's more out there than we might realize. Sure, some Starborn like to stomp around, but I think a lot more like to keep things quiet.
zh: 猜猜看？我觉得外面的东西比我们意识到的要多。当然，有些星裔喜欢大张旗鼓，但我认为更多星裔喜欢悄无声息。

#en: Maybe there's a kinda "pull" that drags multiple Starborn into the same universe, like a cosmic magnet.
zh: 也许存在某种"引力"，像宇宙磁铁一样把多个星裔拽进同一个宇宙。

#en: All a matter of perspective, I suppose. Although, it is odd how often we all seem to bump into each other...
zh: 我想这都取决于视角吧。不过，我们老是撞见彼此，这确实很怪……

#en: Hard to say. From one angle, you could say it's just a handful. From another, you could argue there are infinite Starborn!
zh: 很难说。从一个角度看，你可以说只有一小撮。从另一个角度看，你也可以说星裔是无穷无尽的！

#en: How many other Starborn are out there?
zh: 外面还有多少别的星裔？

#en: These days, I try my best to avoid either of them. Along with any other Starborn who give themselves a grandiose title.
zh: 如今，我尽量避开他们两个。也避开任何给自己安上浮夸头衔的星裔。

#en: I even fought The Emissary once! And I lost... badly. But they let me live. Not exactly sure why, but I wasn't about to stick around and ask.
zh: 我还跟星使交过一次手！而且输得……很惨。但他们放过了我。不太清楚为什么，但我可没打算留在那儿问。

#en: Yeah... I've encountered them. A couple times, actually! Or at least, variations of them.
zh: 是啊……我遇到过他们。其实是好几次！至少是他们的一些变体。

#en: We're a byproduct of a process outside our understanding! The truth of The Unity? Hah. I don't think we'll ever know! And I'm okay with that.
zh: 我们是一个超出我们理解的过程的副产品！归一的真相？哈。我觉得我们永远不会知道！而我不介意。

#en: I'm convinced The Unity exists for something beyond just granting us powers. Frankly, I think Starborn are just a happy accident!
zh: 我确信归一的存在意义并不只是赋予我们能力。坦白说，我觉得星裔只是个意外之喜！

#en: But enough stalling, you asked for my take on things, so here it is!
zh: 好了，别拖了，你问了我的看法，那我就说吧！

#en: Maybe that's why some keep returning to it. Repeating the cycle again and again. They're chasing answers they can't quite see...
zh: 也许这就是有些人不断回到那里的原因。一遍又一遍地重复这个循环。他们在追逐自己看不清的答案……

#en: You know, anyone who claims they've got Unity all figured out is either lying or fooling themselves. Starborn or not, we're all just guessing.
zh: 你知道，任何声称自己完全搞懂了归一的人，要么在撒谎，要么在自欺。不管是不是星裔，我们都只是在猜。

#en: Have you ever met The Hunter or The Emissary?
zh: 你见过星狩或星使吗？

#en: What do you think the Unity is?
zh: 你觉得归一是什么？

#en: What is Unity?
zh: 归一是什么？

#en: *sigh* I'd tell you more but -- it's one of those things you have to experience yourself. Trust me, you'll understand once you're there.
zh: *叹气*我本想多告诉你些，但——这种事你得亲身经历。相信我，等你到了那儿就会明白。

#en: Embracing Unity grants tremendous power. But there is a cost. One that can be hard to appreciate until it's too late.
zh: 拥抱归一能带来巨大的力量。但那是有代价的。一种直到为时已晚才容易被低估的代价。

#en: Unity is a... place, or maybe a time, where reality's fabric is "thinner", letting you reach out and touch something you probably weren't meant to.
zh: 归一是一个……地方，也许是一段时间，那里的现实之布"更薄"，让你得以伸手触及某种你本不该触碰的东西。

#en: Yeah, I wish I had a clear answer, but it's... it's not as simple as that.
zh: 是啊，我也希望我能有个明确的答案，但……事情没那么简单。

#en: Just what are Starborn?
zh: 星裔究竟是什么？

#en: And I suppose you get some sweet powers too. You know, if you're into that kinda thing
zh: 我猜你还会得到些很酷的能力。你知道，如果你好这口的话

#en: And once that happens, you're on a path you can't just walk away from. A path that leads to a new understanding of the entire universe!
zh: 而一旦那发生，你就踏上了一条无法抽身的道路。一条通往对整个宇宙全新认知的道路！

#en: Though, I'd say the process starts as early as the very first time you touch an Artifact. That physical connection... it sparks something in you.
zh: 不过，我觉得这个过程从你第一次触碰神器时就已经开始了。那种切身的联系……会在你体内点燃某种东西。

#en: Starborn are folks who've stepped through The Unity and come out the other side... changed.
zh: 星裔就是那些穿过归一、从另一侧走出来的人……而且已经改变。

#en: Hope you've got a long enough lever and a good fulcrum to place it on.
zh: 希望你有根够长的杠杆，还有个能撬的好支点。

#en: Guess you're stuck with me! Hah. If you want me gone, you'll have to pry me off the multiverse itself.
zh: 看来你甩不掉我了！哈。想让我走，你得把我从多元宇宙本身上撬下来。

#en: Honestly, I wasn't sure it would work at all. But I'm glad it did. I'd say it's a testament to our... synergy? Yeah, that's a good word for it.
zh: 说实话，我都不确定这能不能成。但很高兴成了。我觉得这证明了我们的……协同？对，这个词不错。

#en: And here we are, still side-by-side in a whole other universe!
zh: 而我们就在这里，在另一个完整的宇宙里并肩而行！

#en: Looks like it! I mean, last time you stepped through The Unity -- we did jump together.
zh: 看来是！我是说，上次你穿过归一的时候——我们确实一起跳了。

#en: The "bond" we have, is it still working?
zh: 我们之间的那个"羁绊"，还有效吗？

#en: Oh! And Chunks, you know, that food stuff? In my universe? Never existed. Do with that information what you will.
zh: 哦！还有块餐，你知道，就是那种食品？在我的宇宙？从来不存在。这条信息你爱怎么用就怎么用。

#en: And before I passed through The Unity, there was even talk of folks reclaiming Earth! Or at least, that's what the official bulletins said.
zh: 在我穿过归一之前，甚至还有人在谈论重新收复地球！至少官方公告是这么说的。

#en: For example, in my universe, the UC won the Colony War outright, and fully absorbed the Freestar Collective!
zh: 比如，在我的宇宙里，联殖彻底赢下了殖民地大战，并完全吞并了自由星系联盟！

#en: There are some key differences, though. Events that unfolded a little differently.
zh: 不过也有一些关键差异。一些事件的发展略有不同。

#en: Really, it's almost a mirror-perfect copy of this one! Similar history, same major powers...
zh: 真的，它几乎是这个宇宙的镜像复刻！历史相似，主要势力相同……

#en: Can you tell me more about your home universe?
zh: 你能多讲讲你原本的宇宙吗？

#en: Oh, and my latest party trick is teleportation! But it's unpredictable. Still kinda hit or miss with that one. I try to avoid it if I can...
zh: 哦，我最新的拿手好戏是传送！但它很不稳定。这一手还算时灵时不灵。能避免我就尽量避免……

#en: I've also picked up a few time-bending abilities! Sometimes I can slow it down or even reverse it! Seems to take a lot out of me, though.
zh: 我还学会了几个扭曲时间的能力！有时我能让它变慢甚至倒流！不过这似乎很耗我。

#en: I can pop up a shield, which has saved my life more times than I'd care to admit. Can fire a beam of energy... What else...?
zh: 我能撑起一面护盾，它救过我命的次数我都不好意思承认。还能发射一道能量光束……还有什么……？

#en: Let's see... I can manipulate gravity! Throw it around like a weapon. Packs a real punch! But if I'm not careful, the recoil can be a bitch...
zh: 我想想……我能操纵重力！把它当武器一样甩出去。威力十足！但要是不小心，反冲力可真够呛……

#en: What kind of powers do you have?
zh: 你有什么样的能力？

#en: Hah... I didn't know if I was dreaming or had gone mad! It was pretty cool, though.
zh: 哈……我不知道自己是在做梦还是疯了！不过还挺酷的。

#en: The whole experience was weirdly... personal. Like I was being invited to a dinner for one. And then, when I actually entered the Unity...
zh: 整个体验诡异得……很私人。就像被邀请参加一场只有一个人的晚宴。然后，当我真正进入归一的时候……

#en: Strangely enough, I didn't run into any Starborn! At least, none that I noticed.
zh: 奇怪的是，我没遇到任何星裔！至少没注意到。

#en: I scavenged every Artifact I could track down, rigged together the Armillary in some abandoned shipyard...
zh: 我搜寻了每一件能追踪到的神器，在某处废弃的造船厂里拼出了浑天仪……

#en: It was nothing too special, at least compared to some of the other stories I've heard. For the most part, I went about it the usual way.
zh: 这没什么特别的，至少跟我听过的其他一些故事相比。大体上，我是按常规方式做的。

#en: What was finding The Unity like in your universe?
zh: 在你的宇宙里，找到归一是什么感觉？

#en: As far as Starborn go, I think that makes me a seasoned amateur!
zh: 就星裔而言，我觉得自己算是个老练的业余选手！

#en: But, if I had to put a number on it, I'd say I passed through The Unity... twenty-six times! Yeah, twenty-six, before I first met you!
zh: 但要是非要说个数，我穿过归一……二十六次！对，二十六次，在我第一次遇见你之前！

#en: ...You know, I've honestly lost track. After the first dozen, details start to blur. It's like... skimming pages of the same book again and again.
zh: ……你知道，我老实说已经记不清了。过了头十几次，细节就开始模糊了。就像……一遍又一遍地翻同一本书。

#en: Just how many universe jumps have you made?
zh: 你到底跳跃过多少个宇宙？

#en: You don't have to continue, let's talk about something else.
zh: 你不必继续说，我们聊点别的吧。

#en: After that, the colony was just left to rot. But for me, Londinion's destruction is only half the story.
zh: 在那之后，殖民地就被弃置荒废了。但对我来说，隆蒂涅恩城的毁灭只是故事的一半。

#en: Largest outbreak ever recorded! And as people tried to evacuate, a UC admiral had the starport blown sky-high. A lot of people died as a result.
zh: 有记录以来最大规模的爆发！当人们试图撤离时，一名联殖上将把太空港炸上了天。很多人因此丧命。

#en: Huh. I thought it was common knowledge... Londinion was overrun by Terrormorphs.
zh: 嗯。我以为这是常识……隆蒂涅恩城被骇变兽占领了。

#en: Thanks. I appreciate it.
zh: 谢谢。我很感激。

#en: Destroyed? Just what happened to Londinion?
zh: 被摧毁？隆蒂涅恩城到底发生了什么？

#en: Hah, sorry. Didn't mean to bring the mood down. Let's talk about something else!
zh: 哈，抱歉。不是故意扫兴。我们聊点别的吧！

#en: It's been a long time since I've seen any of them, and I... I just... I just miss them, you know?
zh: 我已经很久没见过他们中的任何一个了，而我……我只是……我只是想念他们，你知道吗？

#en: But in every other universe I've visited, Londinion is the way that you know it. And everyone I ever knew, or cared about, is dead, or never existed...
zh: 但在我到过的其他每一个宇宙里，隆蒂涅恩城都是你熟知的那个样子。而所有我认识或在乎的人，都已死去，或从未存在过……

#en: Not abandoned. No destruction. Everyone alive! My friends, my family...
zh: 没有被废弃。没有被摧毁。所有人都活着！我的朋友，我的家人……

#en: So, I'm Starborn, right? Which means I can jump universes. Well, in my home universe, Londinion is just fine!
zh: 所以，我是星裔，对吧？也就是说我能跳宇宙。嗯，在我原本的宇宙里，隆蒂涅恩城好好的！

#en: If you're willing to share, I'd like to hear the rest.
zh: 如果你愿意说，我想听完剩下的部分。

#en: But they did leave behind a lot of logs and dusty records to help my search. And slowly but surely, I found more Artifacts...
zh: 但他们留下了大量日志和积灰的记录，帮了我不少。就这样一点一点地，我找到了更多神器……

#en: So, I started chasing every Artifact I could find. Unfortunately though, in my universe, Constellation had long been disbanded...
zh: 于是，我开始追查每一件能找到的神器。可惜，在我的宇宙里，星宿座早已解散……

#en: Could tell it was a piece of something bigger. And for whatever reason, I got it into my head that I needed to find more of them!
zh: 看得出它是某个更大东西的一部分。不知为何，我脑子里冒出个念头：我得找到更多！

#en: For me, it all started after finding an Artifact -- floating out in a deserted corner of space. Was funny... Almost like it was waiting there for me.
zh: 对我来说，一切始于发现一件神器——它漂在太空一个荒凉的角落。说来好笑……简直就像在那儿等我一样。

#en: But that's not why it's a sore topic for me. No, not quite...
zh: 但这不是它让我难受的原因。不，不完全是……

#en: But I... I don't really want to talk about it. Sorry...
zh: 但我……我真的不太想谈这个。抱歉……

#en: Londinion! Or at least, what's left of Londinion. That's where I used to call home.
zh: 隆蒂涅恩城！至少是隆蒂涅恩城的残骸。那里曾是我的家。

#en: If you didn't know, Londinion is an abandoned colony on the planet Toliman II. Some call it "abandoned", but a more apt description would be destroyed.
zh: 如果你不知道的话，隆蒂涅恩城是南门二II上的一座废弃殖民地。有人称它"废弃"，但更贴切的说法是"被摧毁"。

#en: You've been to Toliman II. You saw for yourself the fate of Londinion. "Abandoned"? Well, really more like destroyed.
zh: 你去过南门二II。你亲眼看到了隆蒂涅恩城的命运。"废弃"？嗯，其实更像是被摧毁。

#en: What put you on the path to being Starborn?
zh: 是什么让你走上了成为星裔的路？

#en: Their records showed it had been them who were shadowing me the whole time! So, my first brush with Watchtower happened before I even realized.
zh: 他们的记录显示，一直暗中跟踪我的就是他们！所以，我与瞭望塔的第一次接触，在我意识到之前就已经发生了。

#en: At first, I thought it was just other Starborn! They are known to be a bit stalkery, after all. But after I found that first Watchtower computer...
zh: 起初，我以为只是别的星裔！毕竟众所周知，他们有点爱跟踪。但在我找到第一台瞭望塔计算机之后……

#en: For a few good months before, I kept getting the feeling of being watched. I noticed strange faces in crowds or ships that seemed to be tailing me.
zh: 在那之前的几个月里，我一直有种被人盯着的感觉。我注意到人群中的陌生面孔，或似乎尾随我的飞船。

#en: But technically speaking, while that was my first encounter, it wasn't my first exposure to Watchtower.
zh: 但严格来说，那虽然是我第一次正面遭遇，却不是我第一次接触到瞭望塔。

#en: You might know of it as an abandoned colony...
zh: 你可能知道它，一座废弃的殖民地……

#en: Actually, you've already paid it a visit...
zh: 其实，你已经去过一趟了……

#en: Well, it's a rough subject for me. But maybe not for the reasons you might think.
zh: 嗯，这对我来说是个难受的话题。但原因也许和你想的不一样。

#en: Alright, ask away! I'll do my best to answer.
zh: 好，尽管问！我会尽力回答。

#en: You want to ask? Then ask. Any particular topic, or...?
zh: 你想问？那就问吧。有特定的话题吗，还是……？

#en: Sure! But just know, I don't have all the answers.
zh: 当然！但要明白，我并没有所有答案。

#en: I want to ask about the Starborn, about Unity...
zh: 我想问关于星裔、关于归一的事……

#en: Always nice to have a chit-chat!
zh: 能闲聊两句总是好的！

#en: Alright! Anything else?
zh: 好！还有别的吗？

#en: Hope you got the answers you were looking for.
zh: 希望你得到了想要的答案。

#en: I've no more questions.
zh: 我没有其他问题了。

#en: And that's why I'm glad we now have a fleet! It's the only thing that seems to have worked at keeping Watchtower at bay.
zh: 这就是为什么我很高兴我们现在有了舰队！这是唯一真正挡住瞭望塔的办法。

#en: I tried to come up with safeguards, defensive strategies, but none of them really worked...
zh: 我试过想出各种防护措施、防御策略，但都没有真正奏效……

#en: I escaped, of course, and after that, it was a cosmic game of cat and mouse.
zh: 我当然逃掉了，那之后就是一场宇宙级的猫鼠游戏。

#en: I already knew about Watchtower, so I was keeping an eye open. But they still somehow managed to sneak up on me. Almost caught me too!
zh: 我已经知道瞭望塔的存在，所以一直留意着。但他们还是不知怎么就摸到了我身边。差点抓到我！

#en: My first encounter? Let's see... That would be... yeah, it was in orbit around Leonis III.
zh: 我第一次遭遇？我想想……那是在……对，是在狮子座III的轨道上。

#en: I think I already told you about that. It was in orbit around Leonis III. A bunch of Watchtower ships tried to sneak up on me!
zh: 我想我已经跟你说过了。是在狮子座III的轨道上。一队瞭望塔飞船想偷偷靠近我！

#en: Let's see... That would be an ambush in orbit around Leonis III. Yeah, it was a small fleet of Watchtower ships. Thankfully, I saw them coming and got away.
zh: 我想想……那是在狮子座III轨道上的一次伏击。对，是一小支瞭望塔飞船。好在，我发现了他们并脱身了。

#en: What was your first encounter with Watchtower?
zh: 你第一次遭遇瞭望塔是什么时候？

#en: Hm. I like to think it's the former! Gren. Good guy! Glad to have him around.
zh: 嗯。我宁愿相信是前者！格伦。好人！很高兴有他在。

#en: Does that speak to his strength of character? Or did Watchtower just not brainwash him enough?
zh: 这说明了他人格的坚韧？还是瞭望塔就是没把他洗脑彻底？

#en: Despite everything Watchtower does to their members, all the genetic tampering and cyber implants -- he still chose to defect!
zh: 尽管瞭望塔对成员做了那么多——各种基因改造和赛博植入——他还是选择叛逃了！

#en: Hah. Gren's an unlikely ally, that's for sure. Still, I do find it curious, though...
zh: 哈。格伦确实是个意想不到的盟友。不过，我还是觉得挺好奇的……

#en: What do you think about Gren?
zh: 你觉得格伦怎么样？

#en: Harper's a good person. And truth be told, I like her style! And I suppose I like her too.
zh: 哈珀是个好人。说实话，我喜欢她的风格！我想我也喜欢她这个人。

#en: But, after she's had the chance to size someone up, get a feel for 'em, assuming that person is decent -- she'll treat them right.
zh: 但等她有机会把一个人看透、摸清底细之后，只要那人还算正派——她就会好好待他。

#en: She's had a rough life, and so can be a little closed off, even abrasive!
zh: 她这辈子过得不顺，所以可能有点封闭，甚至有点冲！

#en: I don't think most people get Harper, you know? At least, not until they've spent some real time with her.
zh: 我觉得大多数人都不懂哈珀，你知道吗？至少要跟她真正相处过一段时间才行。

#en: What are your thoughts on Harper?
zh: 你对哈珀怎么看？

#en: Somewhere that's... no longer around. Not really...
zh: 一个……已经不在了的地方。不完全是……

#en: ...Ah! Right. That's a fair question. It's not something I usually talk about, but, um, I'm from... Londinion. Sorry if I seem distracted, it's just...
zh: ……啊！对。这问题问得好。这不是我常谈的事，不过，呃，我来自……隆蒂涅恩城。如果我显得心不在焉，抱歉，只是……

#en: I'm from Londinion... I think you already asked me about this, and I'm fairly sure I blew you off. Sorry about that, it's just...
zh: 我来自隆蒂涅恩城……我想你已经问过我这个了，而且我挺肯定我敷衍过去了。抱歉，只是……

#en: Where are you from originally?
zh: 你原本是哪儿的？

#en: Right now? I'm not so sure. I suppose, whatever you think is best.
zh: 现在？我不太确定。我想，你觉得怎么最好就怎么吧。

#en: Hah, that's up to you! You've earned the right to do what you want, when you want.
zh: 哈，那由你决定！你已经挣得了随心所欲做事的权利。

#en: You find any Intel Slates? Maybe Harper could direct you to new Listening Posts to take care of.
zh: 你找到什么情报数据板了吗？也许哈珀能给你指些新的监听哨去处理。

#en: Could always shut down more Watchtower Listening Posts.
zh: 总是可以再关掉一些瞭望塔监听哨。

#en: Why not see if Harper has anything for you? Might be fun to take down a Listening Post or two.
zh: 何不去看看哈珀有没有什么活儿给你？顺手端掉一两个监听哨也挺好玩。

#en: Hmm, how about some more Cyberamps? Maybe get the blueprints for some new models.
zh: 嗯，再来几个赛博增幅怎么样？也许能弄到一些新型号的图纸。

#en: That doctor lady, she can make more Cyberamps, right? Could be worth your time looking into that.
zh: 那位女医生，她能做更多赛博增幅，对吧？也许值得你花点时间看看。

#en: How about fabricating more of those Cyberamps? They seem pretty handy.
zh: 再多制造几个那种赛博增幅怎么样？看着挺实用的。

#en: You checked in with Gren recently? Bet he'd be down to install a Skydrop or two.
zh: 你最近找过格伦吗？我打赌他乐意给你装一两个空投。

#en: I bet there's still more Skydrops we can find blueprints for.
zh: 我打赌还有更多空投的图纸能找。

#en: How about some more Skydrops? Those are always fun.
zh: 再来几个空投怎么样？那玩意儿总是好玩。

#en: If the Fleet Command System can be upgraded, it may be worth getting another ship into the fleet.
zh: 如果舰队指挥系统能升级，也许值得再往舰队里加一艘飞船。

#en: How about some more ships for the fleet?
zh: 给舰队再添几艘飞船怎么样？

#en: Could always add another ship to your fleet. May have to upgrade the Fleet Command System, though.
zh: 总可以再往舰队里加一艘飞船。不过可能得先升级舰队指挥系统。

#en: This "Hunter" and "Emissary", I don't know how much you can trust either of them, but... well, you certainly can't ignore them!
zh: 这个"星狩"和"星使"，我不知道你能信他们多少，但……嗯，你肯定没法无视他们！

#en: Unity. That means something! It's likely Keeper Aquilus can guide you on the right path.
zh: 归一。那一定意味着什么！守护者阿奎勒斯大概能指引你走上正确的路。

#en: My recommendation? I'd take a moment to reflect on the loss of your colleague. I'm sure other members of Constellation would appreciate your presence.
zh: 我的建议？花点时间悼念你那位同事的离世。我相信星宿座的其他成员会感激你的到场。

#en: Constellation needs your attention right now. Given recent events, I'd make it a priority.
zh: 星宿座现在需要你的关注。鉴于近期的事情，我会把它当作优先事项。

#en: If you're looking for a suggestion, conclude your business with Captain Petrov. His Artifact? Its better off in your hands.
zh: 如果你想要个建议，就去把彼得罗夫船长那事做个了结。他的神器？放在你手里更妥当。

#en: Didn't Vladimir want your help repairing The Eye? If I were you, I'd lend a hand!
zh: 弗拉基米尔不是想让你帮忙修天眼吗？换我我就去搭把手！

#en: If I remember, Vladimir had you hunting for more Artifacts. I'd suggest you keep working on that.
zh: 我记得弗拉基米尔让你去找更多神器。我建议你继续办那件事。

#en: I'd think that obvious! Talk to these Starborn guys, or get the hell outta here.
zh: 我觉得这不是明摆着吗！要么去跟这些星裔谈谈，要么赶紧离开这鬼地方。

#en: Wasn't there something in Neon you were meant to be taken care of? Something about Walter Stroud and some kind of purchase?
zh: 霓虹城不是有件事要你去办吗？关于沃尔特·斯特劳和某笔采购的？

#en: Correct me if I'm wrong, but I believe you were meant to be rescuing Barret and making sure he gets back to Constellation in one piece.
zh: 如果我说错了纠正我，但我记得你要去救巴雷特，并确保他完好无损地回到星宿座。

#en: I believe you were in the middle of hunting more Artifacts. I'd suggest you keep going with that!
zh: 我记得你正在找更多神器。我建议你继续干！

#en: You've business on Akila, right? I'd say focus your efforts there. I'm sure Mr. Coe's already provided the relevant details.
zh: 你在阿基拉城有事要办，对吧？我觉得你该把精力放在那儿。我相信科伊先生已经提供了相关细节。

#en: Why ask me when you've got Miss Morgan at hand? Whatever she's asked you to do, I'd say do it!
zh: 你身边就有摩根小姐，何必问我？不管她让你做什么，我觉得你就去做！

#en: My advice? Wrap up your business regarding that Artifact of yours. I'm sure Constellation would be eager to see what you uncovered.
zh: 我的建议？把有关你那件神器的事情收个尾。我相信星宿座会很想看看你发现了什么。

#en: The Armillary is complete, Unity awaits. Pass through, or stay. It's your choice! Just make sure you're ready, okay?
zh: 浑天仪已建成，归一在等待。穿过去，或留下来。这是你的选择！只要确保你准备好了，行吗？

#en: It's time. ...The Hunter, the Emissary? In the grand scheme of your existence, they don't really matter. What does, are your actions. So make 'em good.
zh: 是时候了。……星狩，星使？在你存在的宏大图景里，他们其实并不重要。重要的是你的行动。所以，让它们有意义吧。

#en: My recommendation? Finish up with Nishina Research Station. I'm sure you'll do what's right.
zh: 我的建议？把仁科研究站的事了结。我相信你会做出正确的选择。

#en: You've still a few loose ends with Constellation to wrap up. If I were in your boots, that's where I'd put my focus.
zh: 你和星宿座还有几件没结的事。换作我，我会把精力放在那儿。

#en: Earth, "NASA"... Two words you don't hear much these days. I think you're reaching the end of this particular road. For now, might as well keep walking!
zh: 地球、"NASA"……如今不太常听到的两个词。我觉得你走到这条路尽头了。眼下，既然还走着，就继续走吧！

#en: It's time to take down Watchtower! At least, in this universe... We just need to deal with their starstation...
zh: 是时候干掉瞭望塔了！至少在这个宇宙里……我们只需要解决他们的星际站……

#en: We need to find that Watchtower computer, see if it says what I think it might say... *sigh* Although, I really hope I'm wrong about all this...
zh: 我们得找到那台瞭望塔计算机，看看它说的是不是我以为的那些……*叹气*不过，我真希望这一切我都猜错了……
